purpose: Evidence-ranked environment-design references for RealScale (no game art/model/code/map assets copied).

status_definitions.officially_confirmed_direct: HoYoverse/Genshin official material explicitly names a real landscape and in-game target.
status_definitions.officially_described_environment: HoYoverse describes the game's terrain or mechanics; specific real geographic analogue is not confirmed.
status_definitions.visual_analogy_only: Real landscape suggested by resemblance or geomorphology; NOT an asserted developer inspiration.

constraints: RealScale terrain DEM and existing density fields remain authoritative
Do not alter existing world IDs
Use vanilla material proxies for microforms only
Use separate noise/density development for large landform geometry
No new fluid sources or destructive terrain edits

entries.genshin: Liyue - Jueyun Karst and Mt. Tianheng entrance
entries.real_process: Joint-controlled quartz sandstone weathering and erosion; gorges and natural bridges
entries.next_stage: Regional density-field peak towers and valley networks, preserving distinct sandstone bedrock.

entries.real_process: Carbonate-rich waters deposit terraces, rims and step pools
entries.next_stage: Connect to existing stream slope/flow model; no new water without hydrological verification.

entries.real: Guilin fluvial tower karst and wetland landscape
entries.real_process: Karst towers and cones adjacent to wet lowland river valleys
entries.next_stage: Riverbank reeds and riparian ecology; broad tower-karst density mask.

entries.genshin: Liyue - Chenyu Vale and Qiaoying tea village
entries.real: Humid mountains, cloud forest and managed tea terraces in southern China
entries.real_process: Moist mountain slopes, rock weathering and human agricultural terraces
entries.next_stage: Slope/aspect-aware patchy mist and managed vegetation only where agricultural land is mapped; renderer-specific fog is not a worldgen feature.

entries.genshin: Sumeru - rainforest mountains and ancient giant trees
entries.real: South Asian tropical/moist forests as broad landscape category
entries.real_process: Humid valley slopes, canopy stratification and riparian ecosystems
entries.next_stage: Canopy stratification keyed to climate and exposure; no invented species-level range maps.

entries.genshin: Sumeru - desert, dune valleys and oases
entries.real: Arid-region wind erosion, wadis and groundwater-dependent vegetation
entries.real_process: Aeolian deposition and erosion, local groundwater oasis habitats
entries.next_stage: Separate dune field, rock desert, wadi and groundwater-proxy layers; avoid generating water from scenery.

entries.real: Rocky marine slopes, seamounts and deep-water coral habitats
entries.real_process: Depth zonation and hard-substrate marine ecology
entries.next_stage: Distinct deep habitat zones, currents and coral/sponge substrate constraints.

entries.genshin: Natlan - colorful red-rock plateaus and canyon vistas
entries.real: China Danxia redbed landforms / Venezuela tepui table mountains as morphological analogues
entries.real_process: Redbed erosion and tectonic incision differ from sandstone tepui escarpments
entries.next_stage: Mesa scarps and sedimentary strata through density/strata system; do not conflate redbeds and volcanic basalt.

entries.real: Humid coastal islands, fog belts and maritime forest analogues
entries.real_process: Orographic cloud immersion, salt spray and maritime climate
entries.next_stage: Fog gradients belong in compatible renderer/client ambience; ocean island cliffs remain climate/topography controlled.

entries.real: High-latitude oceanic coastal forest, wetland and island climate analogues
entries.real_process: Coastal exposure, seasonal cold and local moisture, no assumption of specific real site
entries.next_stage: Model temperature/precipitation/sea spray gradients; do not recreate fictional moon energy.
